subject: ACE fastpath registration + PDM/PSM handshake — StoneBridge AI opportunity
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ali Khan <ali_khan@amazon.com>, Sam Patel <sam@stonebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: ACE fastpath registration request — StoneBridge AI

Hi Ali / Sam,

Thanks again for the intro, Ali — appreciate you routing this. Sam, great to reconnect after last week’s call. StoneBridge’s AI inference workload (low-latency recommendation serving) looks like a good candidate for the ACE co-sell path. We’d like to get the registration started under the fastpath checklist so AWS can evaluate for prioritized co-sell support.

Quick context: StoneBridge plans a production trial in Q3 with an expected go-live window in early Q4. They’re asking about listing timelines and whether co-sell support can be scoped to include a joint customer success plan and marketing collateral.

Attached is a completed ACE_registration_form.pdf (basic intake) and a one-page summary of the proposed solution. Can you confirm the next steps on your side (PDM/PSM intro, timeline for review, any procurement gating items)?

Proposed next steps from our side:
- AWS ACE registration (this thread)
- PDM/PSM handshake and mutual action plan (MAP)
- SKU/listing prep + security questionnaire if needed

Sam — copied Marissa (our partner ops lead) to start drafting the MAP and SKU list. Marissa, can you own the MAP doc and loop Ben for pricing-to-commit?

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Sr. GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Attachments: ACE_registration_form.pdf, Redwood-AWS-solution-deck.pdf
From: Sam Patel <sam@stonebridge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ali Khan <ali_khan@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:03:16 -0400
Subject: Re: ACE fastpath registration request — StoneBridge AI

Thanks Soojin — got the intake and the deck, looks good.

A couple notes from StoneBridge side:
- Procurement is on an accelerated track; they’ve earmarked budget for a Q4 production rollout but need a clear listing timeline to firm up the purchase order.
- They’ll need SOC 2 type II evidence and a short note on data residency for logs (US only).

I’ll be on standby for PDM/PSM intros. Our technical lead (cc’d on future threads) will want a short technical Q&A with Redwood runtime/latency folks — can we schedule a 30-min slot next week?

Sam
Founder, StoneBridge AI
sam@stonebridge.ai
From: Ali Khan <ali_khan@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam@stonebridge.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@amazon.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:18:22 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE fastpath registration request — StoneBridge AI

Hi all,

Thanks for the concise packet — we’ve accepted the ACE registration for initial review under the fastpath program. Introducing our PDM/PSM below:

- Priya Ramesh, AWS PDM (pri...@amazon.com) — will own go-to-customer and prioritization
- Liam O'Connor, AWS PSM (liam.oconnor@amazon.com) — will coordinate co-sell enablement and listing steps

Priya / Liam — StoneBridge (Sam) is evaluating Redwood Inference for their low-latency inference tier and is targeting a Q4 production rollout. Soojin / Marissa from Redwood will own the MAP and provide SKU/price guidance. StoneBridge has asked for SOC2 evidence and a data residency confirmation.

Next actions:
1) Redwood to share a draft MAP + SKU list (so AWS and StoneBridge can validate)
2) AWS to confirm listing timeline and any marketplace compliance checks (Priya/Liam)
3) Schedule a 30-min technical sync for StoneBridge technical lead + Redwood runtime lead (suggest Wed 6/20 or Thu 6/21)

I’ll track this on our ACE intake board and let you know when we move to approved-for-co-sell.

Cheers,
Ali
AWS ACE Program
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ali Khan <ali_khan@amazon.com>, Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@amazon.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@amazon.com>, Sam Patel <sam@stonebridge.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 16:27:45 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE fastpath registration request — StoneBridge AI

Thanks Ali — and welcome Priya / Liam. Quick update from Redwood:

Attached is a working MAP (Redwood-stonebridge-MAP.xlsx) that lays out milestones, owners, and expected completion windows. I’ve also included a brief SKU/pricing guidance tab. High level:
- Trial (Q3): 100 concurrent inference RUs, 1M tokens/month
- Production (Q4): 1k concurrent RUs, scale plan with Dedicated capacity

Action items assigned in the MAP:
- Redwood (Marissa) — finalize MAP and upload to the shared Drive link
- Redwood (Ben) — provide SOC2 summary and estimated listing SKU (see pricing tab)
- StoneBridge (Sam) — confirm procurement window and PO holder
- AWS (Priya/Liam) — validate listing slot and compliance checklist

Attached: Redwood-stonebridge-MAP.xlsx (workbook), Redwood-AWS-solution-deck.pdf (product/latency summary).

Sam — for SOC2 we have a one-page evidence summary I can share immediately; full report available under NDA. Linking hubspot deal here for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-7890

Proposed tech sync: Wed 20 June at 11:00 AM PT — if that works I’ll send a calendar invite and include our runtime lead.

Best,
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
